lines.x: Colombia's oil agency has unveiled a plan to restart stalled drilling contracts, aiming to attract US$10 billion in new investment by early 2027.
The Banco de la República reported that inflation increased during the third quarter, moving further from the 3% target.
Colombia's central bank maintained its benchmark interest rate at 12.25% following a divided vote, amid a core inflation rate of 6.0%.
The Banco de la República purchased $2 billion from the Colombian government to bolster the nation's international reserves.
